urls.rationale: Chapter 29B.10 Definitions - title-wide definitions, including lobbying-statute terms (lobby/lobbyist/lobbyist's employer) used by Chapter 29B.50.
Chapter 29B.50 Lobbying Disclosure and Restrictions - the core lobbying-registration and lobbyist-reporting chapter in the post-reorg WA RCW.
Chapter 29B.60 Enforcement - title-wide enforcement and penalty provisions cross-referenced from Chapter 29B.50.

notes: WA reorganized RCW 42.17A into Title 29B circa 2024-2025. Chapter 29B.50 is the new home of lobbying disclosure. Chapter 29B.10 (Definitions) and 29B.60 (Enforcement) are the support chapters the core depends on. Chapter 29B.05 (General Provisions) was considered but excluded as it is likely structural/applicability rather than lobbying-specific definitions; pass-3 will surface its sections if relevant.
